universal.label: Feuerwehr & Rettungsdienst (European Emergency Number)
universal.description: Primary emergency number across Germany and the EU for immediate Ambulance/Emergency Doctor (Notarzt), Fire Brigade (Feuerwehr), and rescue dispatch.

categories.name: Police (Polizei)
categories.description: Dedicated 110 Polizei emergency dispatch across all German federal states.

numbers.label: Polizeinotruf (Police Emergency)
numbers.audience: Anyone witnessing a crime, traffic collision, assault, or security threat in Germany.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 110 for direct connection to the nearest state police (Landespolizei) dispatch center.

categories.name: Medical & Ambulance
categories.description: 112 Notarzt/Ambulance, 116 117 on-call doctor, and crisis support.

numbers.label: Rettungsdienst & Notarzt (Emergency Ambulance)
numbers.audience: Patients experiencing life-threatening conditions, heart attack, stroke, severe accidents, or respiratory failure.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 112 immediately for an emergency ambulance (Rettungswagen) and emergency physician (Notarzt).

numbers.label: Ärztlicher Bereitschaftsdienst (Non-Emergency On-Call Doctor)
numbers.audience: Patients with urgent but non-life-threatening illness outside regular doctor office hours (nights, weekends, holidays).
numbers.whenToUse: Call 116 117 when you need a doctor on nights or weekends but it is not a life-threatening 112 emergency.

numbers.label: TelefonSeelsorge Crisis Helpline
numbers.audience: Individuals in acute emotional distress, depression, or suicidal crisis.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 116 123 (or 0800 111 0 111) for anonymous, free crisis counselling.

categories.name: Fire & Rescue (Feuerwehr)
categories.description: Firefighting, technical rescue, and hazardous materials response.

numbers.label: Feuerwehr (Fire & Technical Rescue)
numbers.audience: Anyone reporting fires, smoke, gas leaks, trapped persons, or severe storm hazards.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 112 and report the location (Wo), what happened (Was), how many injured (Wie viele), and wait for questions (Warten).

categories.name: Women & Child Safety
categories.description: Hilfetelefon Gewalt gegen Frauen and Nummer gegen Kummer.

numbers.label: Hilfetelefon Gewalt gegen Frauen (Violence Against Women)
numbers.audience: Women affected by domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking, or forced marriage.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 116 016 for confidential counselling and shelter referrals in 18+ languages.

numbers.label: Nummer gegen Kummer (Child & Youth Helpline)
numbers.audience: Children, teens, and adolescents facing abuse, family crisis, or danger.
numbers.whenToUse: Call anonymously and free from any mobile or landline in Germany.

categories.name: Autobahn & Cyber Security
categories.description: Emergency card-blocking (116 116) and BSI cyber security authority.

numbers.label: Sperr-Notruf (Emergency Bank Card & Digital ID Block)
numbers.audience: Anyone whose bank cards, credit cards, SIM card, or online banking credentials were stolen or compromised.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 116 116 immediately after theft or cyber fraud to freeze German bank cards and electronic IDs.
